components.note: 土 (earth) — marks soil and earthen things, as in 墙 wall, 地, 城; 壁 is a wall.
辟 (pì) hints at the sound: 壁 bì is close to 臂 bì and 避 bì, which share it.
门 (gate) — marks gates and doors, as in 问, 间, 闪, 开; 闯 shows a horse 马 bursting through a gate.
马 (horse) — the charging animal, as in 骑 ride, 骂.
氵 (water) — marks water and flowing things, as in 河, 海; 漠 is the desert, drained of water, as in 沙漠.
莫 (mò) gives the sound exactly: 漠 mò, also in 膜 mó and 墓 mù.
凯 (kǎi) — triumph, mostly seen in names; as a part it sounds out 铠 kǎi and 恺 kǎi.
亻 (person) — marks people and their actions, as in 你, 他, 做; 侵 is to encroach, as in 入侵; the right side also sounds out 浸 jìn.
巾 (cloth) — marks cloth and coverings, as in 布, 帽, 带, 帮; 席 is a woven mat, then a seat or place at a table.
舌 — a picture of a tongue sticking out of a mouth; compare 活 and 话 which use it as a part.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿, 脑; 胖 is plump.
半 (bàn) hints at the sound: 胖 pàng is close, as in 伴 bàn and 拌 bàn.
钅 (metal, from 金) — marks metals, as in 铁, 钱, 银; 链 is a metal chain.
连 (lián) gives the sound: 链 liàn is close, and 连 also means joined links.
虍 (tiger) — marks the tiger, as in 虎; 虐 shows a tiger with claws out: cruel, savage.
页 (head, page) — marks the head and face, as in 顶, 题, 顺; 预 is thinking ahead.
予 (yǔ) hints at the sound: 预 yù is close, as in 豫 yù.
艹 (plants) — marks grass and plants, as in 花, 草, 菜; 薪 is firewood, then pay.
新 (xīn) gives the sound exactly: 薪 xīn.
氵 (water) — marks water and flowing things, as in 河, 海, 汤; 波 is a wave.
皮 (pí) is a loose hint for bō; 坡 pō and 破 pò share it.
知 (zhī, know) — gives the sound (zhì is close) and the idea: knowing well is wisdom, as in 智慧.
钅 (metal, from 金) — marks metals, as in 铁, 钱, 银; 锁 is a metal lock. The right side matches 琐 suǒ and 唢 suǒ.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk and argument, as in 说, 论, 议; 讼 is a lawsuit.
公 (gōng) is a loose hint for sòng; 颂 sòng shares it.
玉 (jade) — three pieces of jade strung on a cord; the dot tells it apart from 王. As a left-hand radical it becomes 王, as in 球, 理, 珠.
米 (rice) — a picture of grains of rice divided by a line; as a radical it marks grain foods, as in 粉 powder, 粮 grain, 糖 sugar.
宀 (roof) — a house or home, as in 家, 安, 室; 宠 is to keep someone dear and indulged at home.
龙 (lóng) is only a loose sound hint for chǒng.
黄 (huáng) — yellow; as a part it sounds out 簧 huáng and 磺 huáng.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 提; 援 is to lend a hand.
爰 (yuán) gives the sound exactly: 援 yuán, also in 暖 nuǎn and 缓 huǎn.
阝 (hill, from 阜) — marks slopes and boundaries, as in 院, 陆, 阶; 限 is a limit.
艮 (gèn) is only a loose hint for xiàn; 根 gēn and 跟 gēn share it.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body-part radical, as in 脸, 腿; 肮脏 means dirty.
亢 (kàng) is only a loose hint for āng; 抗 kàng and 航 háng share it.
良 (liáng) — good; as a part it sounds out 粮 liáng, 狼 láng, 浪 làng and 朗 lǎng.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk and relations, as in 说, 请, 议; 谊 is friendship.
宜 (yí) hints at the sound: 谊 yì is close, and 宜 also means fitting.
八 (eight) — originally two strokes pulling apart, meaning divide; that sense is in 分 divide, 公 public and 半 half.
心 (heart, mind) — marks the mind and feelings, as in 想, 思, 意; 慧 is a bright mind.
彗 (huì) gives the sound exactly: 慧 huì.
田 (field) — 画 (simplified 畫) originally showed a brush 聿 drawing the borders of a field: to draw lines, hence a picture.
艹 (plants) — marks grasses, as in 花, 草, 茶; 莎 is a sedge grass, seen in 莎士比亚 Shakespeare.
沙 (shā) gives the sound: 莎 shā, also in 纱 shā and 鲨 shā.
囗 (enclosure) — marks walls and confinement, as in 国, 园, 困, 围; 囚 is a person 人 inside: a prisoner.
气 (vapour) — marks air and gas, as in 汽, 氧 oxygen, 气; 氛 is the air or mood.
分 (fēn) gives the sound exactly: 氛 fēn, as in 气氛.
扌 (hand) — marks actions done by hand, as in 打, 拉, 按; 批 is to strike, then to comment.
比 (bǐ) is a loose hint for pī.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — the body-part radical, as in 肝 liver, 脸, 腿; 脾 is the spleen, and by extension temper.
卑 (bēi) hints at the sound: 脾 pí is close to 牌 pái and 啤 pí.
石 (stone) — marks stone and hard things, as in 破, 码, 砖; 碎 is to smash into bits.
卒 (zú) hints at the sound: 碎 suì is close to 醉 zuì and 翠 cuì.
⺮ (bamboo) — marks bamboo and things made of it, as in 笔, 筷, 签; 策 was a bamboo whip or slip, then a plan.
朿 (cì) hints at the sound: 策 cè is close.
各 (gè) is only a loose hint for lüè; 路 lù and 络 luò share it.
纟 (silk thread, from 糸) — marks thread and weaving, as in 线, 红, 绳; 编 is to weave, then to compile.
扁 (biǎn) gives the sound: 编 biān is close, as in 偏 piān and 篇 piān.
车 (cart, vehicle) — marks wheeled things, as in 转, 轮, 较; 辑 originally meant carriage parts, then gathering and editing.
亡 (wáng) hints at the sound: 氓 máng is close to 忙 máng and 盲 máng, which share it.
饣 (food, from 食) — marks food, as in 饭, 饿, 饼; 馅 is the filling of a dumpling or pie.
臽 (xiàn) gives the sound exactly: 馅 xiàn, also in 陷 xiàn.
忄 (heart) — marks the mind and feelings, as in 情, 快, 忙; 懂 is to understand.
董 (dǒng) gives the sound exactly: 懂 dǒng.
氵 (water) — marks water, as in 河, 海, 汤; 温 is warm, like lukewarm water.
昷 (wēn) gives the sound exactly: 温 wēn, also in 瘟 wēn.
木 (wood) — marks wood and plants, as in 林, 树, 桥; 柔 is pliable wood.
矛 (máo) is a loose hint for róu; 揉 róu shares the same part.
王 (king) — the ruler below the crown-like top: 皇 is an emperor, as in 皇帝.
皇 (huáng) as a part sounds out 凰 huáng, 煌 huáng and 惶 huáng.
壴 (drum) — a picture of a drum on a stand; 鼓 adds a hand with a stick 支 beating it.
讠 (speech, from 言) — marks talk and language, as in 说, 语, 话; 读 is to read aloud.
卖 (mài) is only a loose hint for dú; it stands in for an older 賣, as in 牍 dú and 犊 dú.
阝 (hill, from 阜) — marks slopes and barriers, as in 院, 阶, 障; 防 is a dike to guard against floods, then to defend.
方 (fāng) gives the sound: 防 fáng is close, as in 房 fáng and 妨 fáng.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wood, as in 林, 桥, 板; 树 is a tree.
对 (duì) is a stand-in for an older sound part 尌 (shù), not a sound clue itself.
皿 (dish) — marks vessels, as in 盘, 盒, 盖; 益 shows water overflowing a dish: more than enough, hence benefit. 溢 yì (overflow) adds water to it.
